blocks.text: Galvanometer current ko pakarne (detect karne) wala aala hai. Hum is ki andaruni banawat aur kaam karne ka tareeqa nahi parhenge; sirf is ke istemal dekhenge. Yeh aksar null method mein circuits ki durust paimaish ke liye istemal hota hai. Null method mein circuit ko tab tak badalte hain jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye, yani zero reading de. Iska matlab hai ke circuit mein matlooba shart poori ho gayi. Is halat mein galvanometer ke dono siron ka potential barabar hota hai. Galvanometer ki apni resistance hoti hai, magar null reading par us ka koi asar nahi hota, kyun ke us waqt us mein se koi current nahi guzarta. Null method bridge circuits, jaise Wheatstone bridge aur potentiometer, mein aam hai.

Pichle hisse mein dekha ke Wheatstone bridge mein na-maloom resistance null method se naapi jati hai. Galvanometer aamne saamne ke sides ke darmiyani points ke beech laga hota hai. Badalne wali resistance ko tab tak badalte hain jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye. Is waqt bridge balanced hota hai aur na-maloom resistance maloom resistances ki nisbat (ratio) se nikal aati hai.

Potentiometer mein null method se na-maloom voltage ko ek maloom reference voltage se muqabla kar ke naapa jata hai; yeh reference voltage potentiometer ke taar par laga hota hai. Taar par contact ke liye galvanometer aur jockey (sarakne wala contact) istemal hote hain. Null point par jockey aur taar ke sire ke darmiyan potential difference na-maloom voltage ke barabar hota hai. Jockey ki jagah se na-maloom voltage naap liya jata hai.
Null method mein galvanometer ke kuch faide hain:

items: Null method galvanometer ki apni (internal) resistance ka asar khatam kar deta hai, is liye reading zyada durust hoti hai.
Galvanometer bohat hassas (sensitive) hote hain aur 10⁻⁶ ampere jitne chhote currents bhi pakar lete hain.
“No deflection” balance ki seedhi aur saaf nishani hai, is liye null point pehchanna aasaan hai.

blocks.prompt: Null paimaish par galvanometer ki resistance asar kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Null point par galvanometer se koi current nahi guzarta, is liye us ki resistance par potential ka koi girna (IR) nahi hota. Balance ki shart sirf doosri resistances ya lambaiyon par munhasir hai, galvanometer ki resistance chahe kitni bhi ho.

items: Galvanometer current pakarta hai; null method mein circuit ko zero deflection tak badalte hain, jab us ke dono sire ek potential par hon aur us ki resistance ka asar na ho.
Faide: resistance ka asar khatam, taqreeban 10⁻⁶ A tak pakarta hai, saaf balance point.
